accountDetail: Manage sync, recovery, deletion, and sign out.
guestAccountDetail: Your progress stays on this device. Sign in or create an account to sync and restore it.
signedOutAccount: Sign in or create an account
signedOutAccountDetail: Sign in to sync and restore your progress.
accountAttentionDetail: Review sync status, retry, or sign out safely.
verificationPendingDetail: Check your email to finish signing in.
guestAccessBlocked: Sign in to use saved progress
guestAccessBlockedDetail: This saved progress belongs to another account. Sign in to continue.
accountBusyDetail: An account operation is in progress.
signOutDetail: Safely sync pending changes before signing out.
settingsDescription: Manage your app, practice, and privacy preferences.
dataDetail: View the local data contract for this app.
backendDiagnosticsDetail: Run every local backend path on this simulator.
premiumTestingDetail: Simulate Premium entitlement on this test device.
notificationsDetail: Set permission and daily practice reminders.
recoveryDetail: Generate a new set of recovery codes.
emailDetail: Update the email used for your account.
passwordDetail: Manage how you protect your account.
recoveryWarning: Generating 10 new single-use codes will invalidate all previous recovery codes. Save the new codes somewhere safe; they are shown only on this screen.
emailChangeIntro: Verify your identity to send a confirmation link to the new address. Your current email stays unchanged until you confirm that link.
passwordChangeIntro: Confirm your current password and choose a new one with at least 8 characters.
exportAuthenticationIntro: Confirm your identity, return to the data screen, and choose the download action again.
exportAuthenticationFailed: Your sign-in provider could not confirm your identity. Try again.
privacyAuthenticationIntro: Confirm your identity, return to privacy requests, and retry the action.
providerPassword: You sign in with Google or Apple. Manage your password with that provider; this account has no Patternly password.
codesGenerated: Your previous codes are now invalid. Save these 10 new codes before leaving this screen.
codesCopied: Codes copied. Keep them somewhere safe.
emailVerificationSent: Check your new email address for the confirmation link. After confirming, refresh your account details below.
identityRefreshed: Account details refreshed. The address above is your current email.
deleteConsequences: Deleting your account removes your sign-in, saved account progress and recovery codes, and clears learning data from this device. Device preferences remain. Your deleted account and progress cannot be restored.
deletionRetention: GDPR (Articles 5 and 17) does not set a universal retention period for deleted accounts. Technical deletion and security records remain to confirm the operation and prevent reuse of the deleted identity. They cannot restore your account.
deletionContact: For questions about deletion or retained records, contact:
deletionVerified: You can now hold the button below to confirm deletion. This authorization expires after 5 minutes or when you leave this screen.
holdDeleteHint: Hold for at least 3 seconds, then release. Releasing early cancels deletion.
premiumEntryDetail: View the monthly plan, restore purchases, or manage your subscription.
premiumRenewalSummary: No trial. Renews automatically each month at the storefront price until cancelled.
premiumAccountRequiredDetail: Premium is available to users aged 18 or over with a Patternly account. Guest learning remains available.
premiumLoadingDetail: We are checking the current price for your storefront.
premiumUnavailableDetail: The App Store product or RevenueCat public key has not been configured correctly. No purchase can be started.
premiumLoadFailedDetail: Check your connection and try again later.
premiumPaymentDetail: Apple charges your App Store account when you confirm the purchase.
premiumCancellationDetail: Cancel in your App Store subscription settings before renewal. Deleting your Patternly account does not cancel the subscription.
premiumWithdrawalDetail: For the ongoing digital service, withdrawal may involve a proportional charge for service supplied at your request before withdrawal.
premiumInstantStartConsent: I expressly request that Premium starts immediately after purchase and acknowledge that a proportional charge may apply if I withdraw after service has started.
premiumSuccessDetail: The App Store request completed. Patternly access is confirmed by the server and may take a moment to update.
premiumCancelledDetail: You were not charged by this attempt.
premiumActionFailedDetail: No success was recorded. Check your connection or App Store account and try again.
